m400196.倒すことに夢中になって部隊をどんどん展開して\nいっちゃうと、戦況が急に変わった: If you get carried away cutting down foes and keep sending out more troops, you might not be able to place units when the battle suddenly shifts, so watch out for that too.
m400196.別に私たちドワーフが弱いわけじゃないんだよ？\n私の知る限り、ドワーフ族がゴブリ: It's not like dwarves are weak. As far as I know, we've never once been outright defeated by goblins!
m400196.大討伐ミッションの最大の目的は\n『敵を撃破すること』！: The ultimate objective of a Grand Hunt Mission is to crush the enemies!
m400196.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションとは\nいくつか違う点があるから注意してね。: Grand Hunt Missions differ from regular missions in several ways, so stay alert.
m400196.嬉し、い……。\nうぅ……ぐしゅ……本当にありがとう……。: I'm so happy... *sniff* ...Thank you so much...
m400196.実は今、ゴブリンの大軍が王国に進攻しようと\nしているの！: Actually, a massive goblin army is about to invade the kingdom!
m400196.王子の強さは私たちドワーフの里にまで\n知れ渡ってるくらいだし、一緒に闘ってくれ: Your strength is known all the way to our dwarf village. If you fight alongside us, we couldn't ask for a more reassuring ally.
m400196.私の故郷のドワーフ族は、とっても昔から\nゴブリンたちと戦ってきたんだけど……。: My dwarf clan has been fighting goblins since ancient times, but I've never seen them this swarmed.
m400196.私はドロシー。\n背は小っちゃいけど、これでもドワーフ族の戦士なんだよ。\n大地: I'm Dorothy. I'm short, but I'm still a dwarf warrior. Some even call me a earth fairy!

m400267.……あ、重要なことを言うのを忘れてました！\n当地では元々あった道をかき消してし: …Ah, I forgot to mention something important! Occasionally, a sandstorm so fierce can erase the existing paths, so stay alert.
m400267.……お願いします、王子様。\n砂漠の民たちの明日を救うため、\n共に侵略軍を迎え: …Please, Prince. To save the future of the desert peoples, could you help us repel the invading army?

m400267.『戦象』に恐れをなした人々の一部は\n敵軍の戦列に自ら加わるという有り様……。\: Some people, terrified of the war elephants, have even joined the enemy ranks themselves... If this continues, the desert will be swallowed by a vortex of violence.
m400267.えっと……大討伐ミッションでは\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』だけが目的となります: Right… In a Great Hunt Mission, the sole objective is "defeating a large number of enemies."
m400267.し、失礼しますっ！ 王子様、フーリです！\n今日は折り入ってご相談したいことがあ: I—I'm sorry! Prince, it's Khuri! I have an urgent matter to discuss with you today...
m400267.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しませんので、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者:
Because of that, deployment cost won't recover over time,
so don't forget to include anyone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.

Now then, Prince, march out!
The Great Hunt Mission begins!

m400267.それと、今回は敵軍の急襲を防ぐ形となりますので、\nいつものような部隊展開はでき: And this time, we'll be defending against an enemy raid, so we can't deploy our units the way we usually do.
m400267.ですので、傷つくことを恐れずに、\n一体でも多くの魔物を倒すことを考えてください: So don't fear getting hurt—focus on slaying as many monsters as you can.

And the enemies aren't just the desert natives.
You'll also need to watch out for desert-specific monsters like mummies that emerge from pyramids.
m400267.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんの: Also, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops from defeating enemies, so be sure to keep that in mind.
m400267.もし巻き込まれてしまったら、命の保証はできません。\nそれほど危険な砂嵐ですので:
If you get caught in it, I can't guarantee anyone's safety.
It's that dangerous, so I'll tell the troops to fall back immediately if one appears.
m400267.もちろん、理由はどうあれ彼らを許す訳にはいきません。\n……でも正直なところ、私: Whatever the reason, we can't let them go unpunished. …But honestly, with only our own forces, it's going to be hard to deal with their massive army and the monsters...
m400267.今回の戦いは、\n一人でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight is a "Great Hunt Mission"—the goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400267.今回は砂漠での戦いとなりますので、\n兵の皆さんの疲弊は避けられません。\nHP:
This battle takes place in the desert, so the troops will inevitably get fatigued.
They'll be deployed with reduced HP, so watch out.
m400267.仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、どれだけたくさんの敵を\n倒せるかという点が重要になる: Rather than minimizing casualties among our allies, what's important is how many foes we can take down.
m400267.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか違う点がありますので、ご注意し: The Great Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please keep that in mind.
m400267.実はいま、砂漠の国は危機に瀕しています！\n古代に栄えた某国の民を自称する者たち: Actually, the desert kingdom is in crisis! An army claiming to be the people of an ancient, once-great nation has allied with monsters and started invading everywhere!
m400267.彼らがなぜそんな蛮行に踏み切ったのかは不明です。\n魔物に操られているのか、先祖: We don't know why they resorted to such barbarism—maybe they're being controlled by monsters, or perhaps their ancestors' holy lands were desecrated, driving them to rage and radicalism...
m400267.象という動物をご存知ですか？\n体が大きくて、鼻も長くて、ぱおーんって鳴く……。: Do you know elephants? They're huge, have long trunks, and go "pah-oon"... On the battlefield, those elephants become terrifying weapons.

m400376.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on slaying as many monsters as you can.

m400376.悪天候には十分ご注意下さい。: Please be especially careful of the severe weather.

m400376.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: It's more important to eliminate as many foes as possible than to minimize our own casualties.

m400458.──任務了解、目標を『オルカ科学ラボ』の撃滅に設定。: —Mission acknowledged, set objective to annihilate the Orca Science Lab.

—challenge the Kingdom's army to a duel.
Tomorrow morning, meet at the sea southwest of the resort.
They've prepared a mini-mecha battle for us.

m400458.だが、実際どう返答するんだ？\nこれこそ馬鹿正直に受ける義理もないが……。:
But how exactly should we respond?
We don't really have an obligation to accept so bluntly…
m400458.また本作戦はライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nその時点でのキルスコアが戦果と: Also, this mission counts as cleared even if your life reaches zero, and your kill score at that point will be recorded as the result.
m400458.もしこの決闘が遂行されなかった場合、\nオルカ科学ラボは世界征服を開始する──と:
If this duel isn't carried out,
Orca Science Lab will begin world domination—
m400458.わざわざ果たし状まで出して宣言したのは何でだ？\n黙って進めてりゃあ、王国に邪魔:
Why'd they bother sending a formal challenge?
If we just kept moving, the Kingdom wouldn't get in the way.
m400458.シャァァァァク！ 分かってねぇなァ！\nコイツは義理だの損得の話じゃねぇんだ！:
Shaaak! You don't get it!
This isn't about duty or profit!
m400458.トゥアンがすぐフラグ立てるから……。: Tuan's always the one to raise a flag right away…
m400458.世界征服を企む悪の結社に決闘を挑まれた。\nそいつを無視するのが乾いた地の英雄な:
A villainous organization plotting world domination has challenged us to a duel.
Is ignoring that what a hero of the Dry Lands would do?
m400458.今回の作戦は大規模な戦闘が予測されます。\n従って『一体でも多くの敵兵を倒すこと:
This operation is expected to involve large-scale combat.
Therefore, prioritize taking down as many enemy units as possible.
m400458.休暇中にやめてほしいですよねー、\n休みってのは休むためにあるのに。:
I wish they'd quit while we're on vacation—
vacation's supposed to be for resting, after all.
m400458.先程、深海からの使者より手紙を受領しました。\n差出人はオルカレクス総統、手紙の:
We just received a letter from a messenger of the Deep Sea.
The sender is Supreme Commander Orcalex, and the contents—
m400458.分かるような、分からないような……。: I get it, and I don't…

I'll handle navigation to the coordinates.
Everyone, prepare for the mini-mecha battle.
m400458.放っておいても特に害はない気はしますが……。: I feel like leaving it alone wouldn't cause any particular harm…

m400458.最後に、本作戦の結果如何に関わらず、\nEXP、ゴールド、ドロップアイテムなどは: Also, no matter how the mission turns out, you won't receive any EXP, gold, or drop items.
m400458.清々しいくらいに果たし状ですねぇ。: What a refreshingly proper challenge, huh.
m400458.言うなればコイツはプライドの問題だぜ。\n『オレは行く、テメェはどうする』ってな:
You could say it's a matter of pride.
‘I'm going, what about you?' you know.

m400500.──とはいえ、カラザもまた、\nアルミラージの前に敗北した者の一人。\nラタトス: —That said, I too am one of those who fell before the Almirage. Blaming only Ratatoskr is a bit harsh.
m400500.──今年も無事にお祭りを開催できそうですね。: —It looks like we'll be able to hold the festival safely again this year.
m400500.ああ……お労しや、ラタトスク様。: Ah… thank you for your effort, Lord Ratatoskr.
m400500.ああ、それはアルミラージたちが、\nラタトスク様のおやつを全部食べて──: Ah, that's because the Almirage ate all of Ratatoskr's snacks—
m400500.え……それってまさか、私怨……？: Eh… does that mean… a personal grudge…?
m400500.ええと……カワイイのが厄介なんですか？: Um… is being cute the troublesome part?
m400500.ええと、アルミラージというのはですね、\n兎界でも有数のお騒がせ種族のことでして: Um, the Almirage are, you see, one of the most troublesome races even in the Rabbit Realm.
m400500.お祭りで出すご飯を分けてあげたら、\n大人しく棲家に帰ってくれましたよー。: We shared the festival food with them, and they quietly went back to their homes.
m400500.このままではエッグパーティを乗っ取られる他、\n最悪の場合、守護鳥との全面衝突に: If this continues, they'll hijack the Egg Party, and in the worst case it could lead to a full-scale clash with the Guardian Birds.
m400500.これより我ら三名、エッグパーティの成功のため、\nアルミラージに劣らぬカワイイを: From now on, the three of us will showcase cuteness that rivals the Almirage to ensure the Egg Party's success.
m400500.さあ行こう、正義の兎たちよ！\nここからは僕たちのステージだ！: Come on, righteous bunnies! From here on, this is our stage!
m400500.そうだねぇ、汚名は返上しないとだ。: Yeah, we need to clear our tarnished names.
m400500.そうですね、祝祭を守らないと……。: Indeed, we have to protect the celebration…
m400500.そもそもあの子たちは何で封印されてたのよ。\n少しやんちゃなだけの可愛い腹ペコ兎: In the first place, why were those kids sealed up? They're not just cute, mischievous, hungry bunnies.
m400500.それで？ 僕たちが捕まえた\n一角兎たちは結局どうなったんだい？: So? What happened to the one-horned bunnies we captured?
m400500.ちなみにアルミラージさんたちは物持ちが悪いので、\n倒してもEXPやゴールド、ド: By the way, the Almirage are poor at holding items, so even if you defeat them you won't get EXP, gold, or drops.
m400500.はいはい、馬鹿やってないで、\nその兎とやらを止めに行くわよ。: Alright, alright, stop being foolish and let's go stop those rabbits.
m400500.ふふ、つまり今年のエッグパーティは、\n最初からクライマックスということだね！: Hehe, so this year's Egg Party is a climax right from the start!
m400500.ふふふ、最近は何かと騒がしかったが、\n今年もこの季節がやって来たようじゃな。: Hehehe, it's been noisy lately, but it looks like this season has arrived again this year.
m400500.まあ、そこで冷静な判断ができていたら、\nカワイイの権化アルミラージという危険因: Well, if we'd kept a cool head, we might not have let that dangerous “embodiment of cuteness,” the Almirage, go completely berserk.
m400500.アルミラージにはその見た目ゆえに、\n無意識の内に手加減してしまう者も多い。\n: Because of their appearance, many people unconsciously go easy on the Almirage. Watch your own firepower when fighting.
m400500.シュシュもおやつはあるだけ食べちゃうもんね。: Shushu also eats every snack that's left, doesn't she?
m400500.ストライキなんかするからでは？: Maybe because you went on strike?
m400500.マリレーヌ！？ それは言わない約束じゃろ！？: Marylene!? That was supposed to be a secret!
m400500.一年分じゃぞ！？ 吾輩が頑張って貯めた、\n一年分のクルミを一晩で食べられたのじ: A whole year's worth! I worked hard to store a year's supply of walnuts, and they ate it all in one night!
m400500.一応あの子たちが食糧庫に忍び込んで、\n皆の保存食を盗み食いしたお仕置きなので、: Technically, those bunnies snuck into the pantry and stole everyone's provisions, so it's not exactly a personal vendetta…
m400500.事前に何の対策もせず奴らを視認したが最後、\n魅了され、自ら進んで下僕になってし: If you spot them without any prior measures, you'll be enchanted and end up becoming their servant willingly.
m400500.何を仰られますか！ 一大事です！\n先日の騒動で封印の洞が崩れていたらしく、\n: What are you saying! It's a huge matter! Apparently the sealed cave collapsed during the recent incident, and the Almirage have made a massive escape!
m400500.反論できぬことを言うでないわ！: Don't say things I can't refute!
m400500.各員、重要なのは撃破数だと肝に銘じてくれ。\nただし今回の戦場では出撃コストは自: Everyone, remember that the kill count is what matters. However, on this battlefield the deployment cost does not auto-recover. I recommend having a reinforcement request or using a Valkyrie unit composition.
m400500.嫌じゃ聞きとうない！: I don't want to hear that!
m400500.抑圧の結果、兎心の掌握に失敗したのですね。\n圧政者のお手本のような被下剋上シナ: So the oppression failed to seize the rabbits' hearts… a textbook case of the oppressed overturning the oppressor.
m400500.本当に純粋にお腹が空いていただけみたいだね。: It really seems they were just pure, simple hunger.
m400500.現在アルミラージたちの群れが、\nエッグパーティの参加者を巻き込んで、\n世界樹: Currently a herd of Almirage is dragging the Egg Party participants and marching toward the World Tree festival grounds.
m400500.祭り会場付近に防衛ラインを築く。\nこれは可能な限り敵軍の侵入を防ぐ作戦だ、\n: We'll set up a defensive line near the festival grounds. This is a strategy to prevent enemy forces from entering as much as possible; it's a “clear even if your life reaches zero” mission.
m400500.私も、迷惑かけた分は働くわよ。: I'll do my part for the trouble I caused.
m400500.軽い言葉の響きで侮るなかれ。\n奴らの愛らしさは一種の呪いとも言える、\n暴力的: Do not underestimate them because they sound light. Their adorableness is a kind of curse; resisting their violently cute charm is difficult.
m400500.食いしん坊で暴れん坊で……\nだけどあの子たちの一番厄介なのは、\nとんでもなく: Gluttonous and rowdy… but the most annoying thing about them is how unbelievably cute they are, right?

m500476.――あの時と、同じだ。\n確かにこの命は終わったというのに、\nなぜ、まだ力が湧:
It's just like before.
Even though this life is clearly over,
why does power still surge through me…?
m500476.――いいえ、これが最後の戦いだというのなら、\nあなた方には、こちら側で戦っても:
――No. If this is to be the final battle,
you must fight on our side.

――Tch. What is it now?
Aren't you done fighting yet?

――Hah! Hah, hah…
Is everyone back? Roll call!
Roll call by unit!
m500476.――ハハッ、まったくだ。\nラムイエル、そんなことの為に、\n余を呼び覚ましたと:
――Hah! You're right.
Ramuel, you woke me from my slumber
just for something like this?
m500476.――大神ディアスが、\n負けることなど、決してありえない。:
――The Great God Dias
can never, ever lose.

—The God of Love.
The one whose domain is furthest removed from stagnation and peace.
m500476.――我が真なる権能を見せてやろう。: ――Let me show you my true power.
m500476.――滅びは、回避できたと思いますか？: ――Do you think we were able to avert the destruction?
m500476.…………おい、ホルミース。\n私の分の報告書は任せた。:
…………Hey, Holmes.
I'm leaving my report to you.
m500476.…………？\n大きい方の私、何か感じませんか？:
...?
Big me, aren't you sensing something?
m500476.……おい！\nそんなの喰らいたくねぇぞ！:
……Hey!
I don't want to get hit by that!
m500476.……おそらく、大神ディアスとの決戦の日です。\nしかし……これは……？:
……It is likely the day of the decisive battle against the Great God Dias.
But… what is this…?
m500476.……こういう時、どんな顔をすればいいんだ？: ……What face should I make in a situation like this?
m500476.……ふん。\nあの日ここにいた全員を召喚するなんて、\n律儀に主君の復讐でもしよ:
……Hmph.
Summoning everyone who was here that day…
Are you being so diligent about carrying out your master's revenge?
m500476.……もう、会えないと思っていました。\nそして、それでいいと思っていました。:
……I had thought we would never meet again.
And I had thought that was for the best.
m500476.……ようこそ。\n召喚に応えていただき、感謝します。:
……Welcome.
Thank you for answering the summons.
m500476.……ラムイエルよ。\nもう、己を偽る必要はない。\n余のために、これまで十分に尽:
……Ramuel.
You no longer need to deceive yourself.
You have served Me well enough for what it's worth.
m500476.……時空航行で、\n別の時空へのゲートを開く時に似ています。\nいえ……むしろこ:
...It resembles opening a gate to another spacetime during navigation.
No... rather, this is a reverse phase of――
m500476.……神ってのは、自分で自分を変えられない。\n権能と法に縛られて、世界のために生:
……Gods can't change themselves.
Bound by their powers and laws,
they have no choice but to live for the world.
m500476.……移動の、逆。\nわっ、まずっ、まずい！ 急いで王子に連絡を！！\nそれってつ:
……The reverse of movement.
Oh no, this is bad, this is really bad! I need to contact the Prince immediately!!
Does that mean we're being summoned?!
m500476.……証明？\n何を証明しようというの。:
……Proof?
What are you trying to prove?
m500476.……雷の天使、ラムイエル。\nそして、炎の天使、ユーリール。:
……The Angel of Thunder, Ramuel.
And the Angel of Flame, Yuriel.
m500476.ああ、そうしたら、\n敗戦ばかりのお前の戦場に、\nひとつくらい白星を付けてやっ:
Ah, if only I had.
I would have given your string of defeats
a single bright spot.
m500476.ああ、待たせたね、王子。\nどうか、全力で頼む。:
Ah, I'm sorry to keep you waiting, Prince.
Please, give it your all.
m500476.ああ。\n今度は、勝とう。みんなで。:
Ah.
This time, let us win.
Together.

Ah... right, I came here on business.
Are you both free?
Arlette is calling for you.
m500476.あっ、あぁあッ、いけません……それは……。\nこの力は……理想の世界には不要なも:
Ah, no, no… that's wrong… that's…
This power… it has no place in the ideal world…!
m500476.いいんじゃない？\nやりたいようにやりなよ。:
Isn't that fine?
Do whatever you want.
m500476.いたたた……何とか……。\n転移したときに転んじゃったくらい。:
Ow, ow… I'm fine, mostly.
I just tumbled around a bit when the teleportation hit.
m500476.いや……なるほどな。\nユーリールめ、私たちにも戦えと言いたいらしい。:
No… I see.
Yuriel wants us to fight too, it seems.
m500476.うるせぇ！\nただ……ひい爺さんが、\n楽しそうで良かったなって、そう思っただけ:
Shut up!
I just… thought it was good
that Grandpa looked so happy. That's all.
m500476.うわぁ！？\n突然叫ぶな！:
Whoa?!
Don't shout out of nowhere!
m500476.うんうん、どうしたのかなぁ？\nにやにやしちゃってさぁ？:
Mm-hmm, what do you think happened?
He's all grinning and stuff.
m500476.えぇっ！？\n今戦場から戻ってきたばかりなのにぃ！？:
Ehh!?
We just got back from the battlefield!?
m500476.おそらく、それは今回の事象とは\n関連はしていても、\n直接的に繋がるものではな: Perhaps that event is related to what happened this time, but it is likely not directly connected.
m500476.お前は……ディアスの天使か。\nラムイエル、だったか？:
You are… one of Dias's angels.
Ramuel, was it?
m500476.お前は、その願いのためだけに、\nあの日、あの瞬間の要塞宮殿を、\n時空間ごと複:
You replicated the Fortress Palace of that day, that very moment,
along with its spacetime,
and recreated it here, solely for that wish.
m500476.ここは……要塞宮殿……？\nはっ、みんな無事！？:
This is… the Fortress Palace…?
Hah, is everyone okay?!

We just had that battle at the Fortress Palace.
With the shooting stars and the new species of monsters, I think we should be extra cautious.
m500476.この戦いには、\nもうひとつ大切なものが欠けているでしょう？:
This battle is
missing one crucial element, isn't it?
m500476.この戦いも、歌に残してあげましょう。\n弱き者たちの希望、英雄ガレア。:
Let us leave this battle in song.
The hope of the weak, the hero Galea.
m500476.これで全ての戦いが終わりだったらいいのに。\n顔にそう書いてありますよ。: I wish all the battles were over now. It's written all over your face.
m500476.これは、一夜の幻となる戦いだ。\n真なる姿を、ここに見せるがよい。:
This battle is a fleeting illusion.
Reveal your true form here.
m500476.ごめんごめん。\nでもあれからすぐに状況が変わったんだ。\n緊急事態って可能性も:
Sorry, sorry.
But the situation changed immediately after that.
It could be an emergency!
m500476.ご理解いただき、感謝します。: I am grateful for your understanding.
m500476.さぁて、それじゃあ報告書をまとめよっか。: Well then, let's get started on the report.
m500476.しかし、これだけは、\n我が権能そのものたるゼウスだけは奪えなかった。:
But there is one thing
you could not take from me: Zeus, the very essence of my power.
m500476.しかし、どうにも面映ゆいものだな。\nすべて貴様に委ね、散ったばかりだというのに:
Still, it feels rather awkward.
I have just scattered, having entrusted everything to you.
m500476.そうですね。\n実際に、時代を超えた私のような例もありますし――:
I agree.
There are already examples of someone like me crossing eras, after all――
m500476.そして、もう一度あの戦いをやりなおすつもりだと。: And you intend to fight that battle all over again.
m500476.そしてもうひとつは、証明のため。: And the second is for the sake of proof.
m500476.その後は、パーティの準備をしておきます。\n王子にお腹いっぱいご飯を食べさせるっ:
I'll get the party ready after this.
I promised Keranos I'd make sure the Prince eats his fill,
after all.
m500476.それがどうやら、過去のある一点から、\nこちらを探すように放たれている、\nいわ: It appears to be a kind of magical beacon wave, emitted from a specific point in the past, searching for us.
m500476.それでも、ただひとりだけ、\nこの計画を支え続けてくれた者がいた。:
And yet, there was one who stood by this plan
from beginning to end.
m500476.それはこの者らに聞かせるようなことではない。: That is not something to be said before these people.
m500476.それは雷のように始まり、炎のように燃え盛る。\n戦乱の火種にもなり、生命の始まり:
It begins like thunder and burns like flame.
A miracle that can spark war or give birth to life.
m500476.それらは表裏一体であり、\nかつて存在した、ある神の残響そのもの。:
They are two sides of the same coin,
the very echoes of a god who once existed.
m500476.ただ、仲間と共に歩み続ける者。\n王国の、王子だ。:
Just one who walks on, alongside his companions.
The Prince of the kingdom.
m500476.ただ、星を焼き尽くせる程度の雷霆に過ぎない！: It is nothing more than thunder that can burn out the stars!
m500476.だが、この先に待つ未来が、\n余らの想定せざるものになることは確かだろう。:
But it is certain that the future awaiting us
will be one we did not anticipate.
m500476.ちぃエフトラと呼んでください。\n王子がつけてくれたあだ名なので。:
Please call me Chi Eftora.
It's the nickname the Prince gave me.
m500476.ですが、これだけは、\n天使であるこの身にあっても、\n決して消えることのなかっ:
But this alone,
is a feeling that never faded,
even within this body of an angel.
m500476.では、なぜ僕らを呼んだ。: Then why did you call us here?
m500476.では、神話の続きを始めよう。\n王子よ、真なる雷霆を継承したその力、余に見せてみ:
Then, let us continue the myth.
Prince, show me the power of the True Thunderbolt you have inherited!
--- scene: Super Grade ---
m500476.でも、今日みたひい爺さんの顔は、\n何かから解放されたみたいだった。:
But the look on Grandpa's face today…
it was as if he had been freed from something.
m500476.どちらかというと時空関連かな……。\n確か、過去から魔力の波動がなんとかって――:
It's more related to spacetime, I think...
Something about a magical wave coming from the past, if I recall correctly――
m500476.ならば、一度だけ、\n君たちの力を頼っても、いいだろうか。:
Then, just this once,
may I rely on your strength?
m500476.はっ……。\n戦いの後には、\nどのような処罰でもお受けします。:
Y-Yes, my lord.
Whatever punishment you mete out after the battle,
I will accept it.
m500476.ひとつは、死してなお消滅しなかった、\n私という存在が何だったのか、確かめるため: The first is to verify what I am, an existence that did not cease to exist even in death.
m500476.ふふ、逃さないよ？: Fufu, I won't let you escape?
m500476.ふん……呆れた忠義だ。\nつまり、こういうことか？:
Hmph… Pathetic loyalty.
So, is that it?
m500476.まったく、ユーリールめ、\nはた迷惑なことをしてくれやがる……。:
Honestly, Ulyxes,
you really know how to cause a fuss…
m500476.もっと早く、それを言ってほしかったよ。: I wish you had said that sooner.
m500476.ゆえに、お前も好きにするといい。\nこれはお前が整えた舞台なのだ。\n王子の力を:
Therefore, do as you please.
This is the stage you have set.
You wanted to test the Prince's power, did you not?
m500476.よい。我が唯一の臣下の策略だ。\nそれくらい乗ってやろう。:
Very well. It is the scheme of my one and only subject.
I shall indulge you.
m500476.よし、じゃあ報告書は\n夜のパーティまでに各部隊の隊長に提出すること！:
Right then! Everyone, submit your reports
to your squad leaders before the evening party!
m500476.ん、分かった。突然エフトラが\nふたりに増えた時はどうしようかと思ったけど、\n: Hm, I see. I was worried when Ephtra suddenly doubled, but it's good to see you two getting along.
m500476.アルレットが……？\n超古代文明関連で、何かありました？:
Arlette is...?
Is something related to the ancient civilization happening?
m500476.ガレア！\nどうして……あなたは確かに、死んだはずでは……。:
Galea!
Why… you were supposed to be dead…
m500476.ククッ……そうだな。\n立場が逆であれば、貴様を慕う亜神連中の手で、\n真逆の状:
Kukku… That's true.
Had the roles been reversed, it is possible that the sub-gods
who revere you would have woven a situation
that was the exact opposite.
m500476.ケラウノスよ、貴様は確かに、\n我が雷霆を奪っていった。:
Keraunos, you truly did
steal my thunder.
m500476.ディアスも、苦労するね。\n君みたいな、忠義に厚い臣下を持つと。:
It must be a burden for Dias, too.
Having such a fiercely loyal subject as you.
m500476.ディアス様の目指す世界に、\n私の存在は……決してあってはならない――:
In the world Dias-sama seeks,
my existence… must never be allowed to remain—
m500476.ディアス様は、そのようなことは望みません。\n人類に次なる世界を託した意志を、\:
My Lord Dias does not desire such a thing.
I, his servant, cannot defile the will he entrusted to humanity to inherit the next world.
m500476.パルセ、ここが「いつ」の要塞宮殿か分かる？: Paruse, can you tell which time period this Fortress Palace is from?
m500476.世界の崩壊は……遥かな未来に待ち受ける、\n星の終焉は、回避できたのでしょうか。: The collapse of the world... the end of the stars, waiting in a distant future... was that averted as well?
m500476.人の意志だけでなく、\n人類の歴史を背負った此度の戦いは、もしかしたら、\n神の:
Not just the wills of people,
but this battle, which bore the weight of human history,
may have influenced the very nature of the gods.
m500476.人類を信じていると言えば、聞こえはいいだろう。\nだがそれは、創造神を継承する\:
They called it "believing in humanity." A fine-sounding excuse.
But in truth, it was simply an abandonment of the duty
that comes with inheriting the Creator's mantle.
m500476.何者かが、過去から私たちを探していると？: Someone is searching for us from the past?

Shout the name that befits a warrior.
m500476.余の計画に賛同した神は、少なかった。\n誰も彼も、人を愛していると言いながら、\:
Few gods endorsed My plan.
Everyone claimed to love humanity,
yet refused to look at the extinction waiting for them.
m500476.修理中のドーンブリンガーを借りて、\nフローガと一緒に、\n謎の魔力の発信源を調: I borrowed the Dawnbringer while it's under repair and went with Floga to investigate the source of that mysterious magical power...
m500476.十分に戦っていたと思うのですが……？\n詩人としては十分な働きでは？:
I thought we had fought enough, though…?
Wasn't that sufficient work for a poet?
m500476.古き天使である貴様は、知っていたか。\n然り、我が天使の正体とは――:
You, an ancient angel, knew this, did you not?
Indeed, the true identity of My angel is—
m500476.大きい私ばかり、大人ぶってずるい……！: It's not fair for the big me to act so grown-up all the time...!
m500476.己の存在が未来にあってはならないと、\n自ら神の力を捨て、雷と炎の天使となった、:
You, who deemed your own existence incompatible with the future,
cast aside your divine power and became the angels of Thunder and Flame.
My one and only companion, who walked the same path as I.
m500476.思い返せば、\nこの四人で戦場に出たことは、ありませんでした。:
Now that I think about it,

My Lord, my only friend, the Thunder God Dias.
You no longer… grieve for the future, do you?
m500476.我が名はガレア！\n全てを救う英雄を、志す者！:
My name is Galea!
One who aspires to be the hero who saves all!

That you would remember my name.
It is the greatest honor, for you who are all humans acknowledged by my master.

We finally have these unremarkable days in hand.
We simply must make the most of them.
m500476.極めて限定的にではありますが、\n大神ディアスに端を発する一連の危機は、\nこれ: It is a very limited conclusion, but I estimate that the series of crises stemming from the Great God Dias have been averted.

Prince, pull your troops back from the launchers!

The Prince united the wills of people,

Prince, King of Mankind.
Show me the future you envision.

How should I know.

At the moment I replicated,

We were forces gathered individually,
not quite companions.

The Lord Dias I believed in,
the one who should be the king of this world――

Has my observation device been damaged…?

Moreover, communication with the ground is impossible.

The Endbringer Fortress Zeus, is it?
But your hand is already known!

The hero Galea, challenging another hero.
Then, state your name.
m500476.見るがいい！\nこれこそが、文明を消し去る神の雷霆であるッ！！:
Behold!
This is the divine thunder that erases civilization!!
m500476.言葉にすれば、きっとディアス様に笑われてしまいます。: If I put it into words, my Lord Dias would surely laugh at me.

m920006.え！秘術とは何かだって……\nまさか私のことも知らないのか。\n偶然、通りかかっ: Huh! You ask what the secret art is… you don't even know about me? You just happened to pass by?

m920006.彼らは元々魔法に強い耐性がある。\nもちろん私の秘術も魔法を妨害するから\n十分: They've always had strong resistance to magic. Of course, my secret art also disrupts magic, so you'll need to be careful.
m920006.王子！\nあそこに人が、魔物に襲われています！:
Prince!
Someone over there is being attacked by White Goblins!
m920006.私が用意した試練に挑戦する気に\nなったようだね。: Looks like you're ready to take on the trial I prepared.
m920006.私の邪魔をものともせず魔物を倒せれば\n王子の勝ちだ。: If you can defeat the goblins despite my interference, that's a win for you, Prince.

m920006.覚悟のほどはわかったよ。\nでは、その覚悟にふさわしい実力が\n伴っているか試さ: I see you're determined. Then I'll test whether your skill matches that resolve.

m920006.魔物を根絶やしにする覚悟がなければ\n戦うべきではない。\n魔物を避け、隠れた方: Unless you're prepared to eradicate them completely, you shouldn't fight. It's wiser to avoid and hide from them.

Look at that… could she already be…!

Prince!

m920213.わわぁっ！？\n鋼の都の警備機械まで！？:
W-Wha?
Even the security machines from the City of Steel?
m920213.ん……光槍ビルガ？\n貴様の騎士団にいた、あいつか？\nどこにもいないようだが…:
Hm…… the Light Spear, Bilga?
That one who was in your knight order?
I don't see him anywhere, though…….
m920213.ん？ どうして見つめ合ってるんだい？\nミルドリス、あぁいう女騎士が好み？:
Hm? Why are you two staring at each other?
Mildrith, do you have a thing for female knights like that?
m920213.アルコゥが……ドラゴンに変身した……！？: Alcou is…… transforming into a dragon……!?
m920213.アヴァロンが騒がしいから、\nちょっと様子を見に来たんだけど……。\nははぁん、:
??? : Avalon has been rather lively, so
I came to check on things…….
Hm, so you managed to sway Serid?
m920213.アヴァロンのみんなが大事だったのは分かる。\nそれが永遠に続いてほしいって気持ち:
I know how much everyone in Avalon meant to you.
I understand wanting that to last forever.
m920213.オーシェンです。\nこのあたりの領地を治めています。\n今回はシビラ殿下の護衛に: I'm Oshen. I govern the lands around here. I'm here to escort Her Highness Sybilla this time.
m920213.セリド、せめて呼吸を整えてから……。\n威厳とか考えたことある？:
Serid, at least catch your breath first…….
Have you ever even considered having some dignity?
m920213.セリド、私が憎いのは分かります。\nですが今は、あなたの力が必要なのです。:
I know you hate me, Serid.
But right now, I need your strength.
m920213.ゼロから構築するのは、確かに大変ですねぇ。\nでも、それなら既存の技術を使えばい:
Building one from scratch would indeed be difficult.
But in that case, we can just use existing technology.
m920213.タカマガハラの神々と似てるね。\n人類を見守ろうなんて、さすがは神さま！:
That's similar to the gods of Takamagahara.
Deciding to watch over humanity, just like the gods!
m920213.タカマガハラみたいに、\nみんなで引きこもっていれば\nそれで良かったじゃないで:
If we'd just stayed shut away in Takamagahara,
like we were supposed to,
everything would have been fine!
m920213.タリエちゃんなんでここにいるの！？\n戦場は危ないんだから！ 早く離れて！:
Tallier-chan, why are you here!?
The battlefield is dangerous! Get away from here, quickly!
m920213.タリエ？ 何か気になることでも？: Tallier? Is something on your mind?
m920213.ティル・ナ・ノーグを出た私や、\nアヴァロンを出たアランのように、\n世界に関わ: Those who, like me when I left Tír na nÓg, or like Aran when he left Avalon, decided to watch over humanity by becoming part of the world.
m920213.パパへの義理は果たしたから。\n僕は、そうだな……広い世界でも見に行ってくるよ。:
I've done my duty to Papa.
So I'm going to…… go see the wider world, I guess.
m920213.プリニースが「この本読み終わるまで待ってー」とか\n言ってたからですよ！: Prineas was saying, “Wait until I'm done with this book,” you know!
m920213.プリニースさん、なにか手がかりはありましたか？: Prineas, did you find any clues?
m920213.メンテナンスと言いながら、\nどっぷり数ヶ月こもって読書三昧してるけどね。:
You call it maintenance, but you end up
buried in here for months, lost in your books.
m920213.モルちゃん……。\nでも、でもぉ……。でも、私は――:
Mor-chan…
But, but… I… I can't…
m920213.中には魔術師が、絶対に読ませないために\n攻撃魔術を仕込んだ魔導書まで存在したり:
In fact, some mages have even inscribed
offensive spells into grimoires
to make sure no one ever reads them.
In other words, they shoot magic at you.
m920213.亜神セリドは、私の育ての母なの。\n捨て子だった私を、大きくなるまで育ててくれた:
The demi-god Serid is my foster mother.
She raised me from when I was a foundling until I grew up.
m920213.亜神ディアスが危険視するような要素など、\nここには何ひとつ残っていませんよ。:
There are no elements left here
that the Sub-deity Dias would consider a threat.
m920213.亜神ディアスの待つ、要塞宮殿。\nあの超高空にたどり着く技術は、\nまた振り出し: The fortress palace where the Demi-God Dias awaits. It seems the technology to reach that stratosphere has taken us back to square one…….
m920213.交渉のテーブルに着いてくれるならいいけど……。\nとりあえず出てくるの、待とっか:
It would be nice if she would sit down to negotiate, but…
For now, let's just wait for her to come out.
m920213.仕方ないな……一応、これも命令だから。\n亜神セリド、痛くないようにするから、許:
???: I suppose there's no choice… technically, this is an order.
Demi-god Serid, I'll try not to hurt you too much. Forgive me.
m920213.何かブレイクスルーがあればなぁ。\nたとえば、超古代文明の知識とか！: I wish we could make some breakthrough. Like, knowledge from a hyper-ancient civilization!
m920213.何にせよ、やる気になってくれたならそれでいい。\n王子、全力で相手してやろうぜ！:
Whatever the case, it's good that she's fired up.
Prince, let's give it our all!
m920213.僕はパパの頼みを、一応聞いてあげたい。\nだから、セリドを処分するのを邪魔しない:
I'd like to do Papa a favor, if only for now.
So please don't interfere with getting rid of Serid.
In return, I won't lay a finger on you.
m920213.冗談言わないで。\n私の言葉がすべて呪詛になるのは、覚えてるでしょう？:
Don't be ridiculous.
You remember, don't you? Every word I speak becomes a curse.
m920213.叡智の園の者でも理解できない書物を……？\n里長、それはいったい……。:
A book that even the scholars of the Garden of Wisdom can't decipher……?
Village Chief, what on earth are you……?
m920213.同僚だったのに、あの人の趣味知らないの？\nあの人は……人類の技術が大好きなの。:
You were colleagues! Don't you know his hobbies?
That person…… absolutely loves human technology.
m920213.増援か……。\n早くヘルメルクを倒さないと、\n戦場がますます混乱しますね……。:
Reinforcements…….
We need to take down Hermerk soon,
or the battlefield will descend into complete chaos…….
m920213.大きな生ける魔導書という可能性も……。: Or perhaps a giant, living grimoire……
m920213.娘より子供っぽいんだけど！？\nそれでもアヴァロン最高の叡智を備えた亜神！？:
You're more childish than your own daughter!
And you're supposed to be the demi-god of supreme wisdom in Avalon!
m920213.彼も、その例外なのよ。\n本当に強い運命に守られているの。:
He is an exception, too.
He is truly protected by a powerful destiny.
m920213.待ってモルフェサ。\nあなたも一緒に来ない？:
Wait, Morfessa.
Won't you come with us?
m920213.待って！ ストップ！\n里長！ 私里長なんだけど！！:
Wait! Stop!
Elder! I'm the Elder, you know!!
m920213.慣れていないと、この寒さは身にしみるでしょう。\nこの国の北部はほとんどが豪雪地: If you're not used to it, this cold must be biting. Most of the north of this country is a heavy snow zone. Here, please, have something warm to drink.
m920213.戦乱の時代は、数多の知識が人の命を奪った。\n二度と繰り返させはしない。:
In times of war, countless pieces of knowledge have claimed human lives.
I will not let that happen again.
m920213.戦闘もなにも、\nここにいるのは封鎖領域の管理者だけで――:
Battle?
The only ones here are the administrators of the sealed zone, and――
m920213.放棄……ですか？\nアスガルドのように、\n滅びた領域だと聞いていたのですが……:
Abandoned?
I had heard it was a destroyed realm,
like Asgard…….
m920213.書物はおまかせします、プリニース。\nここは私が引き受けますから。:
Leave the books to me, Prineas.
I'll handle this.
m920213.最初からそう言ってるじゃないですか。\n英雄王の末裔に、私に、叡智の園の当代の里:
I've been saying that from the very beginning.
We have the descendant of the Hero King, myself, the current village chief of the Garden of Wisdom,
and even the successor to the Light Spear, Bilga, all in one party.
m920213.未練も何も、このあたりの都市国家すべてで、\n全員納得の上で決めた方針ではありま:
Attachment or not, this was a policy decided upon
with the full consent of everyone in all the city-states in this region.
m920213.正直、パパにそこまで肩入れする理由はないけど……。\n契約はちゃんと守っておかな:
Honestly, I don't have a reason to take my father's side that far…….
But I must keep my contracts.
m920213.母親の威厳とか知ってる！？\nあぁもう、泣きすぎ！ 私の服で拭かないで！？:
Do you have any idea what a mother's dignity is?!
Oh, for heaven's sake, stop crying! And don't wipe your face on my clothes!
m920213.気にしないで。\n互いにご先祖さまが結んだ契約なのだから。:
Please, don't worry about it.
It's a contract our ancestors made, after all.
m920213.気をつけたまえよ、可愛いお姫さまたち。\nそして助力が必要なら、私の名を呼ぶとい:
??? : Be careful, my dear princesses.
And if you need assistance, just call my name.
m920213.無事だった遺物くんの知識でも、\n要塞宮殿への移動についてはお手上げみたいだしね: Even the knowledge from the artifacts that survived is no help when it comes to getting to the fortress palace.
m920213.無限書庫の守護者が竜人なんて、私聞いてないぞ！！:
For the Warden of the Infinite Library to be a dragonkin……
I never heard that!!
m920213.王子、またゴーレムたちが来ます。\n全部叩き斬って、セリドに話を聞いてもらいまし:
Prince, the Golems are coming again.
Let's smash them all and make Serid listen to reason.
m920213.王子だっけ？\n出会ったばかりの亜神に、思い入れはないでしょ？\nここはひとつ、:
The Prince, was it?
You don't have any attachment to a Sub-deity you just met, do you?
How about we make a deal.
m920213.王子！ 斥候から合図が！\n前方に雪原の魔物が現れたようです！:
Prince! The scouts are signaling!
It looks like monsters have appeared in the snowfield ahead!
m920213.知らん。\n我に命令して良いのは創造主たる竜神様だけだ。:
I don't care.
The only one who has the right to command me is the Dragon God, my creator.
m920213.確か……そうそう、ちょうど王国の地下に、\n巨大な建造ドックがあったはず……。:
If I recall correctly…… that's it, there should be a
massive construction dock under the kingdom…….
m920213.神が特権的な立場である必要は、もはやない。\nどのような関わり方であれ、\n我々:
There is no longer any need for gods to hold a privileged position.
In whatever form our involvement takes,
we shall be those who watch over humanity's growth――
m920213.神の使命？ 超越者の責務？ 人類の庇護？\nそんなのどうでもいいんですよ！:
A god's mission? The duty of the transcendent? Protecting humankind?
I don't care about any of that!
m920213.神の座を捨て、人や動物、自然と同化し、\n物質界の住人として生きていくことを決め:
Those who decided to abandon their seats as gods, merge with humans, animals, and nature,
and live as inhabitants of the material world――
m920213.神獣……ミルドリスか？\n英傑たる神獣騎士が、盗人に落ちぶれるとは……。:
A Divine Beast…… Mildrith, is it?
For a Divine Beast Knight of the Heroes to fall so low as to become a thief……
m920213.私がここを出た頃にハマってたのは\n魔法都市の防衛技術だったから、\nそろそろ、:
When I left, he was obsessed with
defense technology for the magic cities, so
by now, he's probably deployed them in droves.
m920213.私たちの加護や、英雄王の血筋だけじゃない、\n彼自身の強い意志と誓いが、あなたの:
It isn't just our blessings or the bloodline of the Hero King.
His own strong will and oaths will repel your curses.
m920213.私にも事情があったんですよ。色々と。: I had my reasons. Many of them.
m920213.私の気持ち、わかりました？\n伝説や神話は、容易に解釈不一致の\n騙し討ちをしか:
You understand my feeling, don't you?
Legends and myths are prone to sudden
ambushes of misinterpretation.
m920213.私はいつでも威厳たっぷりです！\n見ててください！:
I am always full of dignity!
Just watch me!
m920213.私はオラティル。\n件の番人ちゃんと同じく、人類に文明をもたらした者さ。:
I am Ollathair.
Like that Warden, I am one who brought civilization to humanity.
m920213.私も実際にあったことあるわけじゃないけど、\n天界は実在して、神様もいるんでしょ:
I haven't actually seen one myself, but
the Heavens are real, and the gods exist, right?
m920213.立ち去れ、侵入者。\nここは我が盟友の封じた、禁断の知識の園だ。:
??? : Leave, intruders.
This is the Garden of Forbidden Knowledge, sealed by my ally.
m920213.立場上、公的な場では\nどうにも堅苦しいやりとりばかりなので……。: Given my position, interactions in formal settings tend to be rather stiff……
m920213.簡単に入れてくれるとは思えませんが……。\n今は、どんな可能性も無駄には出来ない:
I doubt they'll let us in easily, though……
But we can't afford to waste any possibility right now.
m920213.絶対とは言えないけどね。\nこの世界、この時代にない知識が欲しいなら――: I can't say for sure. But if we need knowledge that doesn't exist in this world, in this era――
m920213.綺麗なところね。\nセリド様が離れたくなかったのも、少しわかるかも。:
It's a beautiful place.
I can see why Serid didn't want to leave.
m920213.聞こえてますよ！？\n外で悪口言ってるの！！:
I can hear you, you know!?
Talking bad about me out there!!
m920213.自分で歩いてください。\nそのうちお尻に根っこが生えて\nトレントになっちゃいま:
Please walk on your own.
If you keep doing that, roots will grow out of your backside
and you'll turn into a treant.
m920213.色んな設計図を引いてみたけどさ、\nベースにしている技術が同じである以上、\nあ: I've sketched out all sorts of designs, but as long as the underlying technology is the same, twisting and turning things around just leads to the same result.
m920213.落ち着いて、レクテ。\n取って食べたりするような子じゃないから。: Calm down, Rekte. She's not the type to eat people.
m920213.視界が悪くなれば、\n遠くを狙うのが難しくなります。\n皆さん、吹雪に気をつけて:
Visibility is going to drop, making long-range attacks difficult.
Everyone, be careful in the blizzard!
m920213.許さなくていいです。\n置いていったのは、事実ですから。:
You don't have to forgive me.
I did leave you behind, after all.
m920213.読解できない、理解できないだけで、\n知識の塊はここにいっぱいあるんだ。:
We may not be able to read or understand them, but
this place is overflowing with knowledge.
m920213.誰が盗人ですか！\nここの知識が必要なんです。\n言って分からないなら、この槍で:
I'm no thief!
I need the knowledge here.
If you won't tell me, I'll make you understand with this spear!
m920213.警戒されている……？\n例の守護者、というやつでしょうか。:
We're being watched……?
Could it be that Warden we heard about?
m920213.警戒しないでほしいな。\n大丈夫、私はきみたちの味方だよ。\nどこかの、世界の味:
??? : Please don't be so wary.
It's alright. I'm on your side.
Unlike the "friends" of some other world, that is.
m920213.超古代文明の文献もあったけど……。\n言語は読めても、技術面がさっぱり。:
There were documents from a hyper-ancient civilization, too…….
I can read the language, but the technology is a complete mystery.
m920213.迷子になるくらいならともかく、\nほら、あぁいうヤバイ本もいるからさ。:
Getting lost is one thing, but look,
there are some dangerous books in here, too.
m920213.過保護すぎるからよ！\nお母さんは、何もかもに過保護すぎるの！:
Because you were too overprotective!
Mom, you're overprotective about everything!
m920213.門番……でっかいゴーレムとか……？: A gatekeeper…… like a big golem……?
m920213.顔じゃなくて、槍を見てください。ほら。: It's not about the face, look at the spear. There.
m920213.魔導書には魔力が宿る。\n魔力はやがて偽りの意思を生じさせ、生ける本となる。:
Grimoires are imbued with magical power.
Eventually, that power gives birth to a false will,
turning them into living books.
m920213.魔法で使役されている魔物、というのも……？: Or a magical beast controlled by sorcery……?
m920213.（ああ、しばらく外に出ないとこうなりますよね）: (Ah, I suppose that's what happens if you don't go outside for a while.)
m920213.（あれ……あの騎士さんの持ってる槍……。\nすごく見覚えがあるような……）:
(Huh…… that spear the knight is holding……
It looks so familiar……)
m920213.（そういうものですか……？\n騎士たるもの、常在戦場の心構えがなくては……）:
(Is that how it is……?
As a knight, one must always be prepared for battle……)
m920213.（それも、そうよね……。\nだって、ここにはもう、あの人しか――）:
(I suppose that's how it is…….
After all, there's no one here but that person――)
m920213.（ただ、私は別に友がいないわけではなくてですね？\n立場上どうしても、他者との関:
(It's not that I don't have friends, you see?
My position just requires me to keep a certain distance from others……)
m920213.（んん……あの騎士殿の武具、\nご先祖さまの手記で読んだ記憶があるような……）:
(Hmm…… I feel like I've read about that knight's armor
in my ancestors' notes……)
m920213.（何も変わってない。\nここだけは、戦乱とは無関係だと言っているみたい）:
(Nothing has changed.
It's as if this place alone is unrelated to the war.)
m920213.（叡智の園まで護衛についてきてと、\n急に言われた時には驚いたものでしたが……。:
(I was quite surprised when I was suddenly asked to escort Her Highness Sybilla all the way to the Garden of Wisdom……
Thank you for your consideration, Your Highness.)
m920213.（良かったわね、オーシェン。\nやっぱりあなたを連れてきて正解だったわ）:
(Good, Oshen.
I knew bringing you along was the right call.)
m920213.（騎士じゃないなら、\nダラダラしても良いってことでしょ？）:
(If you're not a knight,
I guess you can just laze around, right?)

m920224.……ああ、お邪魔させてもらおう。: ……Ah, very well. I shall allow myself to intrude.
m920224.……ああ、今回の慰安旅行の幹事をやっている子か。: ...Ah, you're the one organizing this relaxation trip.
m920224.……うん、分かった。それとありがと、\nあなたたちに褒められるのは光栄だわ。:
...Yeah, I get it. And thanks.

It's an honor to be praised by you all.
m920224.……そう言ってもらえると助かる。\nハイデマリー、私はお前を尊重しよう。\n相談:
……It helps to hear that.
Heidemarie, I respect you.
If you have any concerns, please don't hesitate to write to me.
m920224.……イコルが手伝ってくれて助かりました。\n彼女がエスネアたちを補助してくれなけ:
...I'm glad Ikol lent a hand.
If she hadn't assisted Ethnea and the others,
this hot spring might have been destroyed.
m920224.……次は、完全に防ぎます。我が翠花に誓って。: ……Next time, I will block everything. I swear it on my Jade Flower.
m920224.……申し訳ありません、少し冷静になりました。: ……I apologize. I've calmed down a bit.
m920224.──そのあたりでやめておけ、\nさもなくばこの一帯を凍らせる。:
……That's enough.
If you don't stop, I'll freeze this entire area.
m920224.──って、なんか広間が騒がしい？: ──Wait, why is the main hall so noisy?
m920224.あ、ありがたいお言葉です……。: Oh, that's very kind of you to say...
m920224.あっ、こんにちはラシティさん。\nエメルダさんと、ナナリーさんも。\nここの温泉:
Ah, hello, Lasithi.

Emelda, and Nanaly, too.

Have you already tried the springs here?
m920224.あとでまたエフネちゃんと一緒に来よっかな！: Maybe I'll come back here with Efune later!
m920224.あなた……みんなで温泉に入りたかっただけでしょ？: You... you just wanted an excuse to get everyone in the bath with you, didn't you?
m920224.あははは……ちょっと遠慮したいかなー？: Ahaha… I think I'll pass on that one?
m920224.あらヨシノ、先に入らせてもらってるわ。\n素敵な温泉街に招待してくれてありがとう:
Oh, Yoshino. I'm going to step in first.
Thank you for inviting us to such a lovely hot spring district.
m920224.あれ、宴会ってもう終わっちゃった？\nあんみつを用意してきたんだけど……。:
Huh? Is the banquet already over?
I brought some anmitsu……
m920224.あれ、棄権っすか？ あっちゃー、それは残念っすねー。: Huh, are you withdrawing? Oh dear, that's a shame.
m920224.あれ、私の鎌も急に元気になって──: Oh, my scythe is suddenly feeling energized too—
m920224.あれでも偉大な豊穣神のはずなのですけどね……。: Even though she's supposed to be the great Goddess of Bountiful Harvests…
m920224.あれもあれで、有用なところはあるのだがな……。: Though, I suppose there is some merit to the situation…
m920224.いえ、すごいのは私ではなく温泉ですので。: Oh, please, the credit goes to the spring, not to me.
